title: SDV Testbench - Software Defined Vehicle Test Platform
summary: A research testbench reproducing an experimental Software-Defined-Vehicle (SDV) orchestration scenario across a 4-node Raspberry Pi K3s cluster with real-time and TSN/TAS network constraints. The 'SDV' here refers to Software Defined Vehicle, not the Synthetic Data Vault project, and no evidence shows any use of the SDV synthetic-data library.
evidence: README title: 'SDV Testbench - Software Defined Vehicle Test Platform'; no SDV-family code or dependency calls found
needs: Confirm no relation to Synthetic Data Vault; requirements.txt header only says 'SDV Testbench' with no matching package names in evidence.
